title: P3SUM: Preserving Author’s Perspective in News Summarization with Diffusion Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Using a political perspective classifier to evaluate the political leaning (left, center, right) of generated news summaries and comparing them to the original source articles to calculate stance preservation success rate and stance distance. The paper also measures inherent model bias by calculating the frequency of leftward versus rightward shifts when summarizing center-leaning articles.
